data.description: Customers will receive a Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey via email one day after returning from their holiday. If they do not respond, a reminder email will be sent within the first week of their return.
data.name: Post-Holiday Feedback

template.callout: Get valuable insights that can lead to service enhancements and increased customer loyalty.

fulfillments.description: Open the campaign and edit the scenario to fit your brand and messaging. Launch the campaign in just a few clicks with this ready-made template developed by our experts.

fulfillments.description: This survey will be opened when customer clicks on NPS 'good' or 'awesome'. Open the survey and adjust the wording to your liking. Note that if you change the survey name, you will need to adjust the URL referring to the survey in the email template.

fulfillments.description: This survey will be opened when customer clicks on NPS 'bad' or 'average'. Open the survey and adjust the wording to your liking. Note that if you change the survey name, you will need to adjust the URL referring to the survey in the email template.
fulfillments.headline: Survey Low NPS
